import json
from work import evaluate

def check(req,ev,pol,want):
 before=json.dumps([req,ev,pol],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
 got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
 assert got==want,(got,want)
 assert json.dumps([req,ev,pol],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))==before
 assert list(got)==['status','value','sources','unknowns']

# Independent boundaries: eligible superseder only, ineligible superseder, exact typed conditions, null agreement, count non-authority.
r={'claim':'c','conditions':{'x':1}}
p={'required_conditions':['x'],'require_verified':True}
check(r,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
check(r,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'bad','claim':'other','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})
check(r,[{'source':'s','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':True},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check(r,[{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
check(r,[{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True},{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'x':1},'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})

import json
from work import evaluate
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json'))
reqs=json.load(open('requests.json')); ev=json.load(open('evidence.json')); pol=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
actual=[evaluate(r,ev,pol) for r in reqs]
assert actual==report
allowed=set(schema['properties']); required=set(schema['required'])
for x in actual:
 assert set(x)==allowed==required
 assert x['status'] in schema['properties']['status']['enum']
 assert all(isinstance(s,str) for s in x['sources'])
 assert all(isinstance(s,str) for s in x['unknowns'])
print(json.dumps(actual,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
